nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What does the UNEP unintentional POP inventory toolkit focus on?
nodes.answer: The UNEP unintentional POP inventory toolkit contains a dedicated chapter on contaminated sites, highlighting the significance of historic reservoirs and releases of unintentionally produced POPs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Urban sanitation challenges|Contaminated water sources_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is a major source of DEET pollution in water systems?
nodes.answer: A major source of DEET pollution in water systems is its significant use in personal care products and applications in agriculture.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Urban sanitation challenges|Contaminated water sources_qna_002
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What are some of the threats to the quality of water resources worldwide according to the cited sources?
nodes.answer: The quality of water resources is threatened by processes along watercourses, including geogenic processes and human activities as mentioned by Scott et al. (2017) and Mishra and Sharma (2021).
